text:
elaine: Quick sync — need a short prioritization decision for private deploy networking before we lock Q3 scope. Customers are converging on 3 asks: preserve egress IP, operator shim for tenant lifecycle, and an offline installer profile with KMS/HSM ops. Can we rank and set launch gates?

michael: +1. propose PRESERVE_EGRESS and OPERATOR_SHIM as M1. Offline installer M2. preserving egres IPs is the most frequent blocker for netops.

ravi: Agree with prioritization. But two caveats: (1) preserve-egress requires NAT-swim lanes + IP allocation UX; (2) operator shim depends on final CRD contract (we should lock API).

ash: For rollout ops: if we do PRESERVE_EGRESS as M1, acceptance criteria should include: a) verified end-to-end connectivity with preserved IP; b) automated e2e test from customer env; c) documented rollback path for NAT change.

elaine: Exactly. Draft acceptance gate (short):
- M1: preserve-egress verified in 2 customer pilots + e2e test pass + runbook for rollback
- M1: operator-shim API doc + operator E2E in staging cluster
- M2: offline installer: airgap packaging + KMS integration tests

michael: Quick estimate: preserve-egress ~3 dev-weeks infra + 2 srlg for testing. operator shim ~4 dev-weeks (CRD + lifecycle hooks). Offline installer ~3-5 dev-weeks because of packaging matrix.

devon: Are we comfortable with risk of backwards compat during upgrade? Customers hate forced cutovers. We should include an explicit 'zero-downtime upgrade' acceptance for M1.

ravi: Zero-downtime depends on KV/cache compatibility across versions. If we ensure dual-run support for X->X+1 for 48h we can avoid forced cutovers. That adds ~1 week.

elaine: Good call. Add upgrade constraint: "no forced tenant cutover for minor upgrades" to M1 gate. If team accepts timeline, I'll push commit to roadmap doc and ping field.

ash: Field asks to surface in comms: list of customers who require static egress IPs (ACME, BankCorp, TeleHealth). We should get a one-pager for legal/Sales showing SLA impact.

michael: Also remember cloud-provider constraints for static egress in certain regions. Add a note: some regions require BYO-NAT or use cloud egress appliance — doc linked: https://redwood-internal/infra/egress-constraints

sre-bot: deploy-check: PR 1234 (preserve-egress) passed CI, integration smoke failed in eu-west-1 — investigating.

elaine: OK — action items: 1) engineering to confirm rough timeline + signal blockers (michael, ravi) 2) devex to draft operator CRD contract (devon) 3) field to confirm pilot customers & comms one-pager (ash) 4) infra to resolve eu-west e2e flake (sre-bot). I'll send a short doc after this thread with the M1/M2 gates.

michael: I'll update ETA today. If nothing major, we put preserve-egress and operator-shim in Q3 M1 slice.

ravi: FYI: rough rollout plan sketch (pasted):
```
phase 0: internal staging test
phase 1: 2 pilot customers (opt-in)
phase 2: gradual rollout to dedicated customers, with auto-fallback to relay mode
phase 3: GA with docs + migration runbook
```

elaine: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll file the roadmap change and link back here. :thumbsup:

ash: thanks — please tag me when the one-pager is ready so I can prep legal review.

devon: will do the CRD draft tomorrow AM and post to this thread.

elaine: thread closed for now — we reconvene if a blocker shows up from eu-west test.
